lastResponse.text: I hear how urgent this feels, and you’re doing the right thing by acting now. Let’s make a simple plan for tomorrow morning: first, call Legal Aid at 8 0 0, 3 5 9, 1 8 4 5. if busy, call 5 0 3, 5 8 1, 5 2 6 5. Then read them the exact “Date” or “by” line from your notice. What time tomorrow morning do you want me to set as your reminder?
